# #3043: Patch (part 6 of 11): True Craft a Card crafts with about 20% fewer points
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

The True Craft a Card row of #3000's section 5.

## What

True Craft a Card (`meditative-017`) crafts within a point budget, `CRAFT_POINTS_BASE + CRAFT_POINTS_PER_MANA × cost` (`config.rs` `craft_points_budget`, R880–R883). The issue wants about **20% fewer points for True Craft a Card only**. Plain Craft a Card (`core-099`) fuses and uses no points, and the Potions use `CRAFT_POTION_POINTS`. But **Scratch Pad** (`meditative_plus/c026_scratch_pad.rs`), whose header says its budget is True Craft's, uses the same no-frame budget. So the shared constants can't simply change.

Key the budget on the craft prompt's mode. True Craft calls `choose_craft` with no `mode` (c017 line 41), and Scratch Pad passes `"scratch"`. In `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs`, thread the mode through every budget read: `points_budget` (line 74, the no-frame branch), `craft_presets` (line 1157), `roll_offer` (line 1265), `craft_preview` (line 1331) and `validate_recipe` (line 351). Then thread it through `validate_answer`, which `prompts.rs` line 475 calls with `pending.craft_mode`. Plumb it through `effects/choose.rs` (about lines 534–568) and `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs` `craft_preview`, which must receive the prompt's mode. Add a `CraftMode` variant in `wire/craft.rs` (line 54) only if no mode names True Craft's today, regenerating its TS.

The new True Craft budget is the old one scaled by a named constant beside the others in `config.rs`, for example `TRUE_CRAFT_POINTS_PERCENT = 80`. Decide the rounding and rule it. Scratch Pad keeps today's budget; the rejected alternative is Scratch Pad following, because the issue names one card. Check that R1563008 (a Potion's budget sits below the crafter's at its cost, `config.rs` about line 2005) still holds against the smaller budget, and rule which gives way if it doesn't. The client reads the budget from the engine (`preview.pointsBudget`), so it needs no change unless a test hard-codes one.

## Tests
- True Craft's own file (`meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs`: lines 169, 213–276, 395 (`2 + 5 * 3`) and 638), base and Radiant, at several costs.
- Scratch Pad's file: its budget is unchanged.
- `crates/engine/tests/rules/craft.rs` and `craft_modes.rs`: a recipe one point over the new True Craft budget is refused, while Scratch Pad's isn't.
- `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`, if it hard-codes a budget.

## Files
- **Owned:** `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs`, `crates/engine/src/effects/choose.rs`, `crates/engine/src/prompts.rs` (the craft call only), `crates/engine/src/wire/craft.rs` (if needed, with its generated TS), `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs` (`craft_preview`), `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative_plus/c026_scratch_pad.rs` (tests), `crates/engine/tests/rules/craft.rs`, `craft_modes.rs`, `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`, `docs/meditative-set.md` (line 693), and the notes R880 (and R881–R883 where they state the budget).
- **By entry:** the new constant beside `CRAFT_POINTS_*` in `config.rs`; True Craft's row in `spec/08-catalog.md` (line 403), `BUILD.md` (M 17) and `docs/radiant-audit.md`.

## Check
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' craft`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards true_craft`, and the same with `scratch_pad`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-wasm`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy` on each touched crate

### Working in the fullsend tree
This part of #3000 lands on `bot/issue-3000` beside the other parts, with no pull request of its own. One reconcile run makes the branch green, so this part need not pass every check alone, but it tests its own code.
- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card change (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).
- **Rulings** take this sub-issue's own block: R(N×1000) up, for its number N (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). Each has a test named after it and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/N.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- **Shared by entry.** Other parts edit other entries of `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `crates/cards/src/census.rs`, `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/07-tokens.md`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and `BUILD.md`. Change only the entries, rows and constants named here.
- **Left to the reconcile:**
  - `KEPT_SCRIPTS` in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`;
  - the pending patch fragment;
  - any test in another part's file that your change breaks: name it in your summary.
- Commit only the files under `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` that your own types regenerate.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-3000`, not `main` (fullsend).
